correctness.rationale: Posterior moments and selfadjoint filtration give the entire exact spectrum for every Dirichlet shape. Gaussian-tail dominated log-product expansion and half-line Euler–Maclaurin yield the two coefficients in every fixed dimension and, with the derivative and endpoint terms, the triangle constant. Critical exact s=1,2 identities are established by finite binomial telescoping; 148 independent package checks passed. Finite tests do not prove limits.

value.rationale: The trace powers quantify the natural effective spectral dimension for polynomial averaging on simplices. The shape mass exactly controls a universal vanished second term in every dimension; for triangles the nontrivial finite constant and two exact integer-power benchmark identities resolve the first spectral boundary correction. This is more informative than an isolated numerical trace or classical eigenvalue restatement.
